# awscc_apiportal_portal_publication (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::PortalPublication. Drives the publish/unpublish lifecycle of an AWS::APIPortal::Portal. A separate resource keyed on PortalArn with a customer-controlled ChangeToken as the change-trigger. Customers may set ChangeToken to a literal value, a CFN parameter (manual republish), or a Fn::Sub-composed string referencing dependent resources' UpdatedAt attributes (auto-republish through CFN's dependency graph).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `change_token` (String) Customer-supplied change-trigger string. Any change forces a republish on UpdateHandler. Customers may set this to a literal token, a CFN parameter, or a Fn::Sub-composed string (for example, a concatenation of dependent resources' UpdatedAt attributes) to chain republish through CFN's dependency graph.
- `portal_arn` (String) The ARN of the parent portal that this PortalPublication targets.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the changes made in this published version. Forwarded to PublishPortal.description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_portal_publication.example
  identity = {
    portal_arn = "portal_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `portal_arn` (String) The ARN of the parent portal that this PortalPublication targets

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_portal_publication.example
  id = "portal_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_portal_publication.example "portal_arn"
```
